subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should this PR's doctor migration be accepted as the upgrade path for shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` configs?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes a shipped config value and changes how existing configs are repaired, which is a compatibility-sensitive product choice even though the old runtime did not export telemetry for `grpc`.

options.title: Accept the doctor migration
options.body: Merge the stricter config contract with doctor removing legacy `grpc` and disabling active OTLP export until an operator chooses an OTLP/HTTP collector.

options.title: Keep grpc as a config contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR and sponsor the larger real gRPC exporter implementation instead of rejecting the value.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the stricter config contract with doctor removing legacy `grpc` and disabling active OTLP export until an operator chooses an OTLP/HTTP collector.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics exporter and config surface traces back to his commit, making him the best available owner for the compatibility direction.
